C.C.N. Election Report - After the coup, election results rock the new republic  a new party has been voted into the federal parliamentary republic. 

With the recent coup behind them, a long decade of once ruling the Semi-Authoritarian government has come to a close. This marked the first-ever election to be held by the people and not by the government's influence in the system. Oceanice will be forever free from the once authoritarian government that threatened peace and balance of the republic. 

Election Results

The Federal Liberal Republic or F.L.R. has won 34% and 162 seats. Led by Seyra Velnarik, the F.L.R. emerged as the strongest party in the new parliament. Campaigning on promises of civil freedoms, social democracy, and transparent governance, the F.L.R. captured the hopes of a population longing for stability and liberty.

The United Democracy Conservative Front or U.D.C.F. has won 29% and 139 seats.  Marcus Helviks conservative-nationalist U.D.C.F. ran a strong campaign emphasizing security, tradition, and rebuilding the Republics economy through order and discipline. A bitter rival of the F.L.R.

The Free Democratic Coalition or F.D.C. has won 14% and 68 seats.
Elira Kohnstadts centrist liberal party attracted younger voters and business-minded citizens seeking a balance between reform and enterprise.

The Undieted Republic Union or U.R.U. has won 10% and 47 seats.
Dmitrek Varrnos populist party leaned nationalist and pragmatic, drawing voters frustrated with ideological extremes.

The Social Democratic Republic or S.D.R. has won 7% and 32 seats.
Jonas Rekkards social democrats fought for labor rights and welfare protections, resonating in industrial sectors.

The Federation Union Worker or F.U.W./U.W.U. has won 4% and 19 seats. Tarya Linsovs workers party struggled to gain mass support, though it still maintains a strong influence in the factory District.

The Pro-Humanist Capitalist Party or P.H.C.P. has won 2% and  11 seats. Viktor Draemholts far-right, elitist agenda gained traction only among wealthier urban voters.

Seyra Velnarik has officially become the first Furry President of the Oceanice Republic, with the Federal Liberal Republic or F.L.R. securing the majority vote in the nations first free and democratic election following the collapse of the semi-authoritarian regime. With widespread public support, the F.L.R. has taken its place as the leading political force in the republic, promising reforms, inclusivity, and a break from the shadows of the past government.

Celebrations have erupted across the major cities as supporters gather in the streets, waving banners and chanting for freedom, progress, and unity. Opposition parties have acknowledged the results, though some caution that the path ahead will be difficult as the country recovers from decades of authoritarian control.
